ph.quote: | pH | 5.59 mean Salers category vs 5.50 Cantal | pH units | 6 PDO Salers + 6 PDO Cantal, various producers Massif Central, 8-12 months ripening, same cellar. Salers had slightly higher pH and Aw (5.59; 0.94) compared to Cantal (5.50; 0.91) | https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3417/15/2/961 |

ammonia.reason: Low ammonia from deamination during 5-12 mo proteolysis, pH 5.59 limits volatility.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, indole and 4-alkyloctanoic acids from raw pasture milk plus wooden gerle biofilm.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet and Lactobacillus proteolysis in long-aged pressed curd.

blue_moldy.reason: Low 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from fatty-acid beta-oxidation, no Penicillium roqueforti inoculation.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard from residual galactose plus glutamate/lysine on heating pressed paste.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Lactococcus lactis in raw-milk lactic flora.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic and hexanoic acids from raw-milk lipase and rennet lipolysis during ripening.

creaminess.reason: 32.4% fat with 37.6% moisture gives smooth but firm, not creamy, aged pressed body.

crumbliness.reason: Milled, salted and re-pressed tome fractures at curd junctions after 150-day drying.

firmness.reason: 62.4% dry matter, uncooked pressed and 5-mo aged paste with dense protein network.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism and summer pasture terpenes.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by yeasts/LAB.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caproic/caprylic/capric acids, no goat-milk branched-chain signature.

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine Strecker degradation in aging.

melt.reason: pH 5.59 and intact para-casein allows softening and flow, limited by low moisture and high salt.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol and geosmin from natural rind flora and cellar aging on wooden boards.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil from 51.9% fat-in-dry-matter coalescing on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic and low acetic acid from LAB fermentation, buffered to pH 5.59 by proteolysis.

stretch.reason: Uncooked rennet curd, no pasta-filata hot-water kneading or aligned casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide, no high cook; limited methionine catabolism only.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose consumed, slight sweetness from proline, glycerol and dihydroxyacetone.

umami.reason: Glutamate accumulation from extensive peptidase activity during 150-day to 12-mo ripening.
